claims.text: 1991 Israel ended general exit permits; Oslo called the West Bank and Gaza 'a single territorial unit, whose integrity will be preserved'; 2000 ban on Gazans studying in West Bank and registry freeze; 2007 'permit to remain'; >500,000 left Gaza via Erez in Sept 2000 vs ~3,000 permits a month in 2013; Gisha's Bashi: 'Families are separated… It's not about security'; Uzi Landau ties Oslo to attacks.

hm_aj_separation.label: Jillian Kestler-D'Amours, 'West Bank and Gaza divided 20 years later', Al Jazeera, 12 Sep 2013
